तब निम्नलिखित में से कौन सही है ?

questions.stem: Does the function \(f(x) = \begin{cases} x + 5 & \text{if } x \le 1 \\ x - 5 & \text{if } x > 1 \end{cases}\) continuous at \(x = 1\) ?

hi.stem: क्या फलन \(f(x) = \begin{cases} x + 5 & \text{यदि } x \le 1 \\ x - 5 & \text{यदि } x > 1 \end{cases}\) \(x = 1\) पर संतत है ?

questions.subtopic: Order and Degree of a Differential Equation
questions.stem: Find the order and degree of differential equation \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} + \frac{dy}{dx} + y \cdot \sin x = 0\)

hi.stem: अवकल समीकरण \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} + \frac{dy}{dx} + y \cdot \sin x = 0\) की कोटि एवं घात ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions.stem: Find the direction cosines of a line joining two points \((-2, 4, -5)\) and \((1, 2, 3)\).
If \(P(A) = 0.3, P(B) = 0.4\), then find \(P(A/B)\) if A and B are independent events.

hi.stem: यदि \(P(A) = 0.3, P(B) = 0.4\), तो \(P(A/B)\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए यदि A तथा B स्वतंत्र घटनाएँ हैं ।

questions.stem: If \(A = \begin{bmatrix} \cos\alpha & -\sin\alpha \\ \sin\alpha & \cos\alpha \end{bmatrix}\) and \(A + A' = I\), then find the value of \(\alpha\).

hi.stem: यदि \(A = \begin{bmatrix} \cos\alpha & -\sin\alpha \\ \sin\alpha & \cos\alpha \end{bmatrix}\) तथा \(A + A' = I\), तो \(\alpha\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions.stem: If \(y = x^{x^{x - \text{ad inf}}}\), then prove that \(x\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{y^2}{1 - y\log x}\)

hi.stem: यदि \(y = x^{x^{x - \text{ad inf}}}\), तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि \(x\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{y^2}{1 - y\log x}\)

questions._flag: Both prints write the infinite power tower's exponent as "x - ad inf" (a dash, not dots); kept as printed.

questions.subtopic: Adjoint and Inverse of a Matrix
questions.stem:
For two invertible matrices A and B of order \(n\), prove that
\((AB)^{-1} = B^{-1}A^{-1}\).

hi.stem: कोटि \(n\) के दो व्युत्क्रमणीय आव्यूहों A और B के लिये सिद्ध कीजिए कि \((AB)^{-1} = B^{-1}A^{-1}\).

questions._flag: The English word "prove" is broken in the print ("pro c"); completed from the Hindi सिद्ध कीजिए.

questions.stem: Show that the given function \(f(x) = \cos x\) is increasing in \((\pi, 2\pi)\).

hi.stem: दिखाइए कि प्रदत्त फलन \(f(x) = \cos x\) ; \((\pi, 2\pi)\) में वर्धमान है ।

questions.stem: If \([a_{ij}] = 2i - j\), then determine a matrix A of order \(2 \times 3\).

hi.stem: यदि \([a_{ij}] = 2i - j\) हो, तो \(2 \times 3\) क्रम का एक आव्यूह A ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions.stem:
Find the area of a parallelogram whose adjacent sides are given by vectors
\(\vec{a} = 3\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\) and \(\vec{b} = \hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 2\hat{k}\).

hi.stem: उस समान्तर-चतुर्भुज का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए जिसकी संलग्न भुजाएँ सदिशों \(\vec{a} = 3\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\) और \(\vec{b} = \hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 2\hat{k}\) द्वारा निरूपित हैं ।

questions._flag: The Hindi print's vector a comes out as a malformed glyph (like ब with a bar); the English prints a clear \(\vec{a}\), used in both.

questions.stem: Volume of a cube is increasing at the rate of 9 \(\text{cm}^3\)/s. If length of its edge is 10 cm, then its surface area is increasing with which rate ?

hi.stem: एक घन का आयतन 9 \(\text{cm}^3\)/s की दर से बढ़ रहा है । यदि इसके कोर की लम्बाई 10 cm है, तो इसके पृष्ठ का क्षेत्रफल किस दर से बढ़ रहा है ?

questions.stem: Does the relation defined by \(R = \{(x, y) : y \text{ is divisible by } x\}\) on the set \(A = \{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6\}\), an equivalence relation ?
Express the matrix \(A = \begin{bmatrix} 3 & 3 & -1 \\ -2 & -2 & 1 \\ -4 & -5 & 2 \end{bmatrix}\) as the sum of a symmetric and a skew symmetric matrix.

hi.stem: आव्यूह \(A = \begin{bmatrix} 3 & 3 & -1 \\ -2 & -2 & 1 \\ -4 & -5 & 2 \end{bmatrix}\) को एक सममित आव्यूह तथा एक विषम सममित आव्यूह के योगफल के रूप में व्यक्त कीजिए ।

questions.stem:
If \(x\sqrt{1 + y} + y\sqrt{1 + x} = 0\) for \(-1 < x < 1\), then prove that :
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = -\frac{1}{(1 + x)^2}\)

Find the angle between the pair of lines :
\(\vec{r} = 3\hat{i} + \hat{j} - 2\hat{k} + \lambda(\hat{i} - \hat{j} - 2\hat{k})\) and
\(\vec{r} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} - 56\hat{k} + \mu(3\hat{i} - 5\hat{j} - 4\hat{k})\).

hi.stem:
रेखा-युग्मों
\(\vec{r} = 3\hat{i} + \hat{j} - 2\hat{k} + \lambda(\hat{i} - \hat{j} - 2\hat{k})\) और
\(\vec{r} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} - 56\hat{k} + \mu(3\hat{i} - 5\hat{j} - 4\hat{k})\) के बीच का कोण ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions._flag: Both languages print "56\(\hat{k}\)" in the second line's point (an unusual value); kept as printed.

questions.stem:
Find the shortest distance between the lines :
\(\frac{x + 1}{7} = \frac{y + 1}{-6} = \frac{z + 1}{1}\) and
\(\frac{x - 3}{1} = \frac{y - 5}{-2} = \frac{z - 7}{1}\)

hi.stem: रेखाओं \(\frac{x + 1}{7} = \frac{y + 1}{-6} = \frac{z + 1}{1}\) और \(\frac{x - 3}{1} = \frac{y - 5}{-2} = \frac{z - 7}{1}\) के बीच की न्यूनतम दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions.stem: Find the equations of the tangent and normal to the curve \(x^{2/3} + y^{2/3} = 2\) at the point \((1, 1)\).

hi.stem: वक्र \(x^{2/3} + y^{2/3} = 2\) के बिन्दु \((1, 1)\) पर स्पर्श-रेखा और अभिलम्ब के समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions.subtopic: Area Bounded by a Curve and a Line
questions.stem: Find the area of the region enclosed by the parabola \(y^2 = 4ax\) and its latus rectum.

hi.stem: परवलय \(y^2 = 4ax\) और उसके नाभि लम्ब से घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions.stem: Solve the differential equation \(y\,dx - (x + 2y^2)\,dy = 0\)

hi.stem: अवकल समीकरण \(y\,dx - (x + 2y^2)\,dy = 0\) को हल कीजिए ।

questions.subtopic: Graphical Solution and the Feasible Region
questions.stem: Find the maximum value of \(Z = 8x + 5y\) under the constraints \(5x + 3y \le 15\), \(2x + 5y \le 10\) and \(x \ge 0, y \ge 0\) by graphical method.

hi.stem: व्यवरोधों \(5x + 3y \le 15\), \(2x + 5y \le 10\) तथा \(x \ge 0, y \ge 0\) के अन्तर्गत \(Z = 8x + 5y\) का अधिकतम मान आलेखीय विधि से ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions.stem: There are three group of children having 3 girls and one boy, 2 girls and 2 boys, one girl and 3 boys respectively. One child is selected at random from each group. Find the probability that three selected children has one girl and 2 boys.

hi.stem: बच्चों के तीन समूहों में क्रमश: 3 लड़कियाँ और एक लड़का, 2 लड़कियाँ और 2 लड़के, एक लड़की और 3 लड़के हैं । प्रत्येक समूह से यादृच्छया एक बच्चा चुना जाता है । तीनों चुने गये बच्चों में एक लड़की एवं 2 लड़के होने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions.subtopic: Adjoint and Inverse of a Matrix
questions.stem: If \(A = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 3 & 3 \\ 1 & 4 & 3 \\ 1 & 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix}\), then verify that \(A \cdot \text{adj}(A) = |A|\,I\) and find \(A^{-1}\).

hi.stem: यदि \(A = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 3 & 3 \\ 1 & 4 & 3 \\ 1 & 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix}\) हो, तो सत्यापित कीजिए कि \(A \cdot \text{adj}(A) = |A|\,I\) तथा \(A^{-1}\) ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions.stem:
Solve the following system of linear equations by matrix method :
\(x + y + z = 6\)
\(y + 3z = 11\)
\(x + z = 2y\)

hi.stem:
आव्यूह विधि से निम्न रैखिक समीकरण निकाय को हल कीजिए :
\(x + y + z = 6\)
\(y + 3z = 11\)
\(x + z = 2y\)

questions.stem: Evaluate : \(\int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{x\,dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\)

hi.stem: \(\int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{x\,dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions.stem:
Show that :
\(y = c_1 e^{ax}\cos bx + c_2 e^{ax}\sin bx\), where \(c_1, c_2\) are constants, is a solution of the differential equation \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - 2a\frac{dy}{dx} + (a^2 - b^2)y = 0\).

hi.stem:
दिखाइए कि :
\(y = c_1 e^{ax}\cos bx + c_2 e^{ax}\sin bx\), जहाँ \(c_1, c_2\) अचर हैं, अवकल समीकरण \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - 2a\frac{dy}{dx} + (a^2 - b^2)y = 0\) का हल है ।

questions.stem: Prove that : \(\int_{0}^{\pi} \log(1 + \cos x)\,dx = -\pi\log_e 2\)

hi.stem: सिद्ध कीजिए : \(\int_{0}^{\pi} \log(1 + \cos x)\,dx = -\pi\log_e 2\)

questions.stem:
Find particular solution of differential equation
\(\frac{dy}{dx} + y\cot x = 2x + x^2\cot x, (x \ne 0)\) it is given that \(y = 0\) if \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\).

hi.stem: अवकल समीकरण \(\frac{dy}{dx} + y\cot x = 2x + x^2\cot x, (x \ne 0)\) का विशिष्ट हल ज्ञात कीजिए, दिया है कि \(y = 0\) यदि \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\)
